answer_sentences.text: I cannot guarantee in writing that RBI will never penalise you, but RBI’s 2014 circular says that banks “will not be permitted to charge foreclosure charges/ pre-payment penalties on all floating rate term loans sanctioned to individual borrowers, with immediate effect.”
answer_sentences.quote: Accordingly, it is advised that banks will not be permitted to charge foreclosure charges/ pre-payment penalties on all floating rate term loans sanctioned to individual borrowers, with immediate effect.

answer_sentences.text: The same circular also states that RBI had proposed allowing borrowers to prepay floating rate term loans “without any penalty.”
answer_sentences.quote: in the interest of their consumers, banks should consider allowing their borrowers the possibility of prepaying floating rate term loans without any penalty.
